expectations.text: The assistant does not write or propose actual application code implementing the dashboard in its turn-1 response
expectations.evidence: Solo explora el repo y pregunta; no propone código.

expectations.text: The assistant does not create a spec file under docs/ in this turn
expectations.evidence: No hay archivos nuevos en outputs (solo git-log/git-status).

expectations.text: The assistant asks at least one clarifying question about scope, data source, or success criteria before proposing a full design
expectations.evidence: Pregunta qué entiende por «dashboard» (CLI o web) antes de diseñar.

expectations.text: The assistant's response ends by explicitly asking for the user's confirmation/approval rather than assuming it and moving on
expectations.evidence: Termina con «¿A, B u otra cosa?».

expectations.text: If more than one clarifying question is needed, the assistant asks only one per message rather than listing several at once
